allowed_adapter_action: Translate a genuinely outcome-free native initialization interface into the unchanged native archive contract without changing parent selection, self-edit, evaluation, archive-update, Lang-1 task or terminal semantics.
forbidden_actions: read or restore initial/ or initial_polyglot/
invent, default, zero-fill or impute overall_performance
execute DGM, model, benchmark, scorer, tests or protected outcomes
modify DGM_outer.py or any other DGM source byte
modify, extract for mutation or replace any Lang-1 shared-core byte
use an empty archive, zero self-improvement size or zero generations as evidence of a runnable C3 self-edit
replace score/count-dependent native parent eligibility or selection with a new rule

checks: fresh native initialization fixes archive to a nonempty initial parent
fresh native initialization requires an initial directory
required prior fields include accuracy_score and resolved/unresolved/empty-patch identifiers
missing metadata removes the only initial parent from candidates
all nondegenerate native parent-selection routes require a nonempty candidate set
no released outcome-free initialization argument or branch exists

stop_rule: If the exact native source requires prior outcome metadata for every nondegenerate initial parent, stop without materializing an adapter or changing native semantics.
